description: Core implementation of FSUI handling logic, including parsing and evaluating reverse Polish notation expressions, with classes for expression elements, calculator, and expression parsing.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Associates operator/method names with their corresponding actions and registers them in a linked list.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element in the expression, such as a number or operator, with methods to initialize and clear.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Performs parsing, evaluation, and management of reverse Polish notation expressions.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects for efficient expression parsing.

methods.name: LENameOrdinalPair::LENameOrdinalPair
methods.description: Constructor that registers the name-action pair in a linked list.

methods.name: LEElement::clear
methods.description: Resets the element to an undefined state.

methods.name: LEElement::init
methods.description: Initializes the element with an action and optional value.

methods.name: LECalculator::reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator state and logs.

methods.name: LECalculator::add
methods.description: Adds an element to the expression list.

methods.name: LECalculator::pop
methods.description: Pops a value from the evaluation stack.

methods.name: LECalculator::push
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the evaluation stack.

methods.name: LECalculator::processElement
methods.description: Processes an expression element, performing the corresponding operation.

methods.name: LECalculator::getValue
methods.description: Evaluates the expression and returns the result.

methods.name: LEElementPool::next
methods.description: Provides the next available element from the pool.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string token represents a numeric value.

methods.name: getNextToken
methods.description: Extracts the next token from a line of expression.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses a string token into an action enum.
